## v2.2.5

The Linux AppImage fixes `AppRun: Permission denied` for non-root users. Replace the old AppImage with this version; the release pipeline now checks `AppRun` inside the finished package. The Ubuntu 26.04 build baseline is unchanged.

This release also fixes Windows packaging of the pinned iced checkout. It supersedes the unpublished v2.2.4 build; the previous public release was v2.2.3.

Other changes since v2.2.3 include native picture-in-picture playback, interface renderer selection and startup recovery overrides, improved high-DPI window sizing, and standalone startup diagnostics.
